info.title: API.SH: Shopify
info.description: The Shopify API from API.SH: public Shopify data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Filters (`product_type`, `vendor`, `tag`, `available_only`, `min_price`, `max_price`) apply to the products of the page read: with any filter set the response adds `page_size` (products on that page before filtering), `count` and `filters`, and `next_page` still follows the store's own paging. Raise `limit` (up to 250) to filter over more products at once.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-catalog

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Shopify hostname, with or without `https://`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-250; default 5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Keep only products of these product types (comma list, case-insensitive), e.g. `Shoes`.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Keep only products of these vendors (comma list, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Keep only products carrying at least one of these tags (comma list, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only products with at least one variant in stock.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Keep only products with a variant priced at or above this amount (store currency).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Keep only products with a variant priced at or below this amount (store currency).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Filters (`product_type`, `vendor`, `tag`, `available_only`, `min_price`, `max_price`) apply to the products of the page read: with any filter set the response adds `page_size` (products on that page before filtering), `count` and `filters`, and `next_page` still follows the store's own paging. Raise `limit` (up to 250) to filter over more products at once.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-collection

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Shopify hostname, with or without `https://`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-250, or 1-50 with `sort`; default 5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order as the store's own collection page sorts it: best-selling, manual (the store's featured order), price-ascending, price-descending, created-descending, created-ascending, title-ascending, title-descending. With `sort`, `page` follows the store page's paging and `limit` of its products are returned. Omit for the store's product feed order.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Keep only products of these product types (comma list, case-insensitive), e.g. `Shoes`.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Keep only products of these vendors (comma list, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Keep only products carrying at least one of these tags (comma list, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only products with at least one variant in stock.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Keep only products with a variant priced at or above this amount (store currency).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Keep only products with a variant priced at or below this amount (store currency).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every published collection of a store with its product count; pass a collection handle to /shopify/v1/collection for its products. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-collections

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Shopify hostname, with or without `https://`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Collections per page, 1–250 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-search

parameters.description: Shopify hostname, with or without `https://`.

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: types

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per type, 1–10 (default 10).

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Hide sold-out products.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
